subject: App is permanently sleeping and no (archiving/restarting) task is finishing

messages.author: a48dadbe6d0d2651
messages.subject: App is permanently sleeping and no (archiving/restarting) task is finishing
parts:
Hi all,

an application of mine (#268672, "WortschatzSpiegel") is permanently sleeping and it does not "wake up" when accessed by the browser. I also tried to restart it via the shinyapps.io dashboard, but it doesn't seem to work. Also, archiving or deploying the app anew is not working with the error message "Unable to dispatch task for application=268672, there are 1 tasks in progress".

All other apps with on my account work though and also a copy of app 268672 seems to work fine for now (ID of the re-deployed app is 294290).

The logs do not seem to contain any error message. Do you have an idea what's causing this behavior?

Thanks,
Sascha W.

messages.author: a48dadbe6d0d2651
messages.subject: Re: App is permanently sleeping and no (archiving/restarting) task is finishing
parts:
It works again. I did nothing, but apparently the problem is solved.

Best,
Sascha W.
